lines.en: label halloweentwo5:
: Well hooray for me getting to be second place! It is truly an honor to be graced by your presence.
lines.zh: : 哇，我真荣幸能排到第二名！能蒙你大驾光临，真是三生有幸。

lines.en: : Just make sure you don’t start crying or something because it would be really exhausting having to navigate that twice within such a short period of time.
lines.zh: : 只要你别又开始哭什么的就行，这么短的时间里要应付两次那种场面，我可真的会累死。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t you worry about that. I’ll bottle my feelings up and cry when I’m alone, like any other civilized human being would do.
lines.zh: : 哦，这点你不用担心。我会把情绪都憋在心里，等一个人的时候再哭，就像任何一个体面人该做的那样。

lines.en: Once again, I find myself being dragged away from the party by a girl with a visible ribcage.
lines.zh: 又一次，我发现自己被一个肋骨清晰可见的姑娘从派对上拽了出来。

lines.en: Granted, I haven’t seen Io without a shirt on to confirm this yet, but I have a hard time believing that she, like many other girls I commonly associate with, couldn't benefit from eating slightly more.
lines.zh: 当然，我还没见过 Io 不穿上衣的样子，无法确认这一点，但我很难相信她——就像我常来往的许多女生一样——不会从多吃一点当中获益。

lines.en: I suppose that’s a conversation for another day, though.
lines.zh: 不过，这话题大概得改天再谈了。

lines.en: Because Io and I being alone together means things will go one of two ways.
lines.zh: 因为我和 Io 单独相处，事情只会朝两个方向发展。

lines.en: She’ll either self-deprecate and say a bunch of depressing stuff while still managing to keep a smile glued to her face-
lines.zh: 她要么一边自贬、说一大堆丧气话，一边还能把笑容死死地粘在脸上——

lines.en: Or she will, once again, invite me to an amusement park.
lines.zh: 要么，她会再一次邀请我去游乐园。

lines.en: The truth remains to be seen.
lines.zh: 真相究竟如何，还有待观察。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight1
The secret third option, and one of the rarest for Io, is that she’ll elect to remain completely silent and gaze off toward the sky, likely thinking about how much she hates girls or something.
lines.zh: 至于那隐秘的第三种可能，也是 Io 身上最罕见的一种：她会选择彻底沉默，抬眼望向天空，大概在想自己有多讨厌女生之类的。

lines.en: I don’t recall the forecast being cloudy with a chance of misery tonight, but I suppose no weather pattern can be discernible 100%% of the time.
lines.zh: 我不记得今晚的天气预报是「多云，有痛苦的几率」，不过话说回来，也没有哪种天气模式是能 100%% 预测准的。

lines.en: Besides, the silence provides a nice break from the music inside- even if it’s at a noticeably lower volume than it had been the previous year.
lines.zh: 再说，这份安静倒是让人从屋里的音乐里解脱出来——哪怕音量已经比去年明显小了不少。

lines.en: It’s good to know that some of the girls are looking out for some of the others.
lines.zh: 知道有些女生在替另一些女生着想，挺好的。

lines.en: It’s worse knowing that some of them aren’t looking out for anyone at all.
lines.zh: 更难受的是，知道她们当中有些人根本谁都不在乎。

lines.en: : How do you feel about Halloween, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你对万圣节有什么看法，Sensei？

lines.en: : Is this a trick question? Because based on what you said just a few minutes ago, I feel like I might not be {i}allowed{/i} to like it.
lines.zh: : 这是陷阱题吗？因为照你几分钟前说的那些话，我感觉我大概不被{i}允许{/i}喜欢它。

lines.en: : I’m genuinely curious.
lines.zh: : 我是真的好奇。

lines.en: : I’m already set in my ways, but I’ll understand if you think there’s a little more to it than just slutty costumes and sugary treats.
lines.zh: : 我已经定型了，但如果你觉得它不只是「浪荡的装扮和甜食」这么简单，我也能理解。

lines.en: : Or, alternatively, those may be the {i}exact{/i} reasons you like it, and there won’t be anything more to it in your eyes either.
lines.zh: : 或者反过来说，那些也许{i}恰好{/i}就是你喜欢它的理由，在你眼里它同样没有更深的东西。

lines.en: : I think...Halloween is the ideal time for me to be the lecherous, cynical observer I was born to be.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……万圣节是我生来就该当个好色又愤世嫉俗的旁观者的最佳时机。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight2
: So it’s the costumes and {i}not{/i} the sugar that does it for you. Got it.
lines.zh: : 所以让你上头的是装扮，{i}不是{/i}糖。明白了。

lines.en: : I don’t think that should come as much of a surprise.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这应该不算什么意外吧。

lines.en: : It doesn’t. I mean, I’ve more or less figured out what you place at the top of your priority list by now.
lines.zh: : 不算。我是说，你把你心里的优先级排成什么样，我差不多已经摸清楚了。

lines.en: : And you still invite me outside to be alone? Brave move.
lines.zh: : 那你居然还邀我出来独处？胆子不小。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight3
: You don’t have to like {i}everything{/i} about a person if you’re going to...you know, {i}like{/i} them.
lines.zh: : 如果你想……嗯，{i}喜欢{/i}一个人的话，你不必喜欢他身上的{i}一切{/i}。

lines.en: : Sometimes you just get desperate and settle for less than the complete package because you realize the bundle you’re looking for just...doesn’t exist.
lines.zh: : 有时候你只是太渴望了，于是将就着接受一个残缺的套餐，因为你意识到自己想要的那一整套……根本不存在。

lines.en: : Or maybe it’s discontinued or something. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 或者它已经停产了之类的。我也不知道。

lines.en: : But it’s not like I’m going to like you any less for fantasizing about girls in slutty outfits.
lines.zh: : 但我也不会因为你对穿着暴露的姑娘抱有幻想，就少喜欢你一点。

lines.en: : For a lot of people, that’s the only way they can find value.
lines.zh: : 对很多人来说，那是他们唯一能找到自身价值的方式。

lines.en: : They give up on themselves and put their body on display like some sort of perverted art exhibit and wait patiently as all sorts of people approach them and make their offers.
lines.zh: : 她们放弃了自己，把身体像某种变态艺术展品一样摆出来，然后耐心等着形形色色的人凑上来开价。

lines.en: : Which, then, allows us to separate them into two {i}more{/i} categories.
lines.zh: : 于是，我们又能把她们{i}再{/i}分成两类。

lines.en: : Those willing to {i}accept{/i} offers...and those too scared to do so.
lines.zh: : 愿意{i}接受{/i}开价的……和吓得不敢接受的。

lines.en: : Or, I guess there’s a third category as well in the fact that some people are just seeking the sort of validation you can only get from knowing you got someone to orgasm.
lines.zh: : 或者，我想还应该算上第三类——有些人追求的，是那种只有「让某个人高潮了」才能得到的认可。

lines.en: : But those people are the worst of the three, and even knowing they exist is enough for me to write off their presence on this stupid, boring planet.
lines.zh: : 但这三类人里，这类是最糟糕的，光是知道她们存在，就足够让我把她们从这颗愚蠢又无聊的星球上划掉了。

lines.en: So, it appears that it’s going to be another night of depressing observations (Light on the self-loathing) after all.
lines.zh: 看来今晚又要变成一场充满丧气观察的夜晚了（自我厌恶的成分倒是淡了些）。

lines.en: That’s fine, though.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。

lines.en: This is her default state.
lines.zh: 这就是她的常态。

lines.en: And if the pattern is going to break, there needs to be something or {i}someone{/i} who personally breaks it.
lines.zh: 而如果这种规律真要被打破，就得有某件事、或{i}某个人{/i}，亲自来打破它。

lines.en: Io is far too tired of moving to ever break anything on her own.
lines.zh: Io 早就疲于奔波，永远不可能靠自己打破任何东西。

lines.en: : I don’t have a wordy response for you or anything, but I’m glad that the type of person I am hasn’t been enough to push you away yet.
lines.zh: : 我没有长篇大论要回你，不过我很高兴，我这种人还没把你彻底推开。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight4
: So am I.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴。

lines.en: : Sure, I know that a lot of it might just be me intentionally fusing into you the way an anglerfish would while mating.
lines.zh: : 当然，我知道这也许只是我有意要像鮟鱇鱼交配时那样融进你身体里。

lines.en: : Do you know about that? How the males are just parasites who just feed off the females’ nutrients after fusing with them and turn into little, fishy sperm factories?
lines.zh: : 你知道那个吗？雄性不过是寄生虫，融合之后就靠吸食雌性的养分过活，最后变成一座小小的、鱼形的精子工厂。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong here, but are you calling yourself a...fish sperm factory right now?
lines.zh: : 要是我理解错了你纠正我，但你现在是在说自己是……一座鱼精子工厂？

lines.en: scene ioyuminight5
: Heheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Even that might be a little generous.
lines.zh: : 就算这么说，可能都有点抬举我了。

lines.en: : At least the female in the anglerfish scenario has something to gain from the presence of a parasitic male.
lines.zh: : 至少在鮟鱇鱼的剧本里，雌性还能从那只寄生雄性的存在里捞到点好处。

lines.en: : What do you gain from me?
lines.zh: : 你能从我这儿得到什么？

lines.en: : And, if I attach myself to you, much like I already have...how will your life become better?
lines.zh: : 而如果我像现在这样依附到你身上……你的人生会变好多少？

lines.en: : I have nothing of value for you, Sensei. I have nothing to give.
lines.zh: : 我没有任何有价值的东西能给你，Sensei。我什么也给不了。

lines.en: : You don’t have to {i}give{/i} me anything.
lines.zh: : 你不需要{i}给{/i}我任何东西。

lines.en: : We’re not fish. And I certainly don’t intend to reproduce with you.
lines.zh: : 我们又不是鱼。而且我肯定也没打算跟你繁衍后代。

lines.en: : Well...that’s a relief, at least.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那至少算是松了口气。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight6
: Thanks for following me out here, by the way.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，谢谢你跟了我出来。

lines.en: : I thought that after not really making an effort to hang out with me at the beach, you’d already gotten bored or something.
lines.zh: : 我以为你在海滩那次没怎么主动找我玩，已经是对我厌倦了之类的。

lines.en: : But I realize now that it was probably just me overanalyzing things and thinking I was higher up on your list of people to spend time with than I actually am.
lines.zh: : 但现在我明白了，大概只是我自己想太多，以为在你愿意共度时间的人名单上，我的位置比实际要高。

lines.en: : That weekend felt like it just kind of flew by anyway. We’ll hang out more soon.
lines.zh: : 那个周末本来就感觉一眨眼就过去了。我们很快会再一起玩的。

lines.en: : Amusement park? I’m contractually obligated to ask at this point.
lines.zh: : 游乐园？事到如今，我可是有合同义务要问的。

lines.en: : I don’t remember ever signing this contract.
lines.zh: : 我不记得自己签过这份合同。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight7
: That’s cause there was never a signature involved.
lines.zh: : 那是因为从头到尾就没有签名这回事。

lines.en: : You “signed” it when you held my hand underneath the stars just blocks away from where I waste away my youth.
lines.zh: : 你「签」下它，是在那个离我虚度青春的地方只隔几个街区的星空下，握住我手的时候。

lines.en: : Blocks away from where you walked into my life.
lines.zh: : 就在我走进你生命的那个地方的几个街区之外。

lines.en: : First, with a random blonde. Then, with my best friend.
lines.zh: : 第一次，是跟着一个金发路人。第二次，是跟着我最好的朋友。

lines.en: : But now...you come there for me.
lines.zh: : 但现在……你来那里，是为了我。

lines.en: : And once an anglerfish fuses with its partner, it stays there for life.
lines.zh: : 而鮟鱇鱼一旦和伴侣融合，就会一辈子待在那儿。

lines.en: : Even when you get tired of me feeding off of your energy because I’m too weak to find any on my own...even then, I won’t leave you.
lines.zh: : 哪怕有一天你厌烦了我吸食你的能量，因为我太软弱，自己找不到任何能量……即便到那时，我也不会离开你。

lines.en: : So do whatever you want with me in complete disregard for what I want myself and-
lines.zh: : 所以你想对我做什么就做什么，完全不用管我自己想要什么，然后——

lines.en: scene ioyuminight8
: Wait, why do you look so exhausted all of a sudden? Am I talking too much again?
lines.zh: : 等等，你怎么突然一脸疲惫？我又话太多了？

lines.en: : I’m just trying to figure out what the rationale behind tonight's suspiciously composed breakdown is.
lines.zh: : 我只是在想，你今晚这场出奇克制的崩溃，背后的逻辑到底是什么。

lines.en: : Umm...a cry for attention because I waited all night in your room at the beach for the chance to see you only to go home empty handed?
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概是为了博取关注吧，毕竟我在海滩那次在你房间里等了你一整晚，就为了见你一面，结果却空手而归？

lines.en: : A desperate plea for a reason to wake up tomorrow disguised in the form of an education lecture of deep sea fish?
lines.zh: : 或者是一场伪装成深海鱼类科普讲座的、绝望地想要找个明天起床的理由的求救？

lines.en: : You can spin this any number of ways, but it really won’t wind up detracting from how strange it is on a sheer conceptual basis- no matter which way you go with.
lines.zh: : 这些事你爱怎么解读都行，但不管你怎么解读，都丝毫无损于它从纯粹的概念层面就有多奇怪。

lines.en: : Also, I’m terrified that you’ll stop being attracted to me if I don’t do anything to put myself out there the way that gyaru or the annoying green-eyed soccer player do.
lines.zh: : 还有，我真的很害怕：如果我不像那个辣妹，或者那个烦人的绿眼睛足球队员那样主动表现自己，你就会对我失去兴趣。

lines.en: : There wasn’t really a reason for me to drop that part in there, but I’m on a roll tonight, so yeah. Just gonna get that out of the way.
lines.zh: : 其实没什么理由非得把这段插进来，但我今晚状态正好，所以，嗯，索性一并说了。

lines.en: : The costumes aren’t what make me attracted to people, Io. I’ve already told you I’m attracted to you before.
lines.zh: : 让我对人有兴趣的不是装扮，Io。我之前就说过，我对你有兴趣。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight9
: I know. But the average train of events in the case of you being attracted to me would lead to you wanting to take things further.
lines.zh: : 我知道。但一般来说，你对我有兴趣，接下来就会想更进一步。

lines.en: : And without me ever making an effort to actually {i}do{/i} that, the attraction you have toward me might begin to fade.
lines.zh: : 而要是我一直不努力真的去{i}做{/i}点什么，你对我的兴趣可能就会开始消退。

lines.en: : We already know I serve no purpose in simply being around you. So if your attraction, or the last beacon of hope in the soon-to-be warzone that is our relationship, goes away...what’s left?
lines.zh: : 我们已经知道，我光是待在你身边毫无用处。所以如果你的兴趣——也就是我们这段关系在即将变成战场之前最后那座希望的灯塔——消失的话……还剩下什么？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say you haven’t made an effort.
lines.zh: : 我可不会说你没有努力过。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight10
: I would.
lines.zh: : 我会。

lines.en: : Liking someone is confusing for someone like me.
lines.zh: : 对像我这种人来说，喜欢一个人是很费解的事。

lines.en: : There are all of these things that someone like you would call childish floating around inside of my head, like...wanting to hold hands. Or wanting to rest my head on your shoulder.
lines.zh: : 我脑子里飘着一堆你会称之为幼稚的东西，比如……想牵手。或者想把头靠在你肩上。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight11
: But...
lines.zh: : 但是……

lines.en: : Anything more than that is just...
lines.zh: : 比那更多的，就只是……

lines.en: : Hm? The fuck you two doing out here?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你们俩在外面搞什么鬼？

lines.en: scene ioyuminight12
The conversation screeches to a halt as Yumi, once again, shows up to the Halloween party fashionably late.
lines.zh: 随着 Yumi 又一次姗姗来迟地出现在万圣节派对上，这段对话戛然而止。

lines.en: And, just like with Io here, her anti-costume policy reigns supreme in keeping me at the same level of lewd fantasization I always am regarding her.
lines.zh: 而且，就像身边的 Io 一样，她的「反装扮」政策依旧稳坐钓鱼台，让我对她保持着一如既往的猥琐幻想水平。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight13
: This guy harassin’ you?
lines.zh: : 这家伙在骚扰你？

lines.en: : Yumi, come on.
lines.zh: : Yumi，别这样。

lines.en: : Ain’t talkin’ to you, dick. Talkin’ to...whatshername.
lines.zh: : 我又没问你，蠢货。我在问……那个谁。

lines.en: : Io Ichimonji.
lines.zh: : Io Ichimonji。

lines.en: : Right, yeah. Weren’t we supposed to fight for the dorm war or whatever the fuck that was?
lines.zh: : 对，没错。我们不是该为了什么宿舍战争之类的破事打一架吗？

lines.en: : The contest was just about avoiding being {i}in{/i} the contest.
lines.zh: : 那场比赛的规则就是别{i}卷进{/i}比赛里。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Yeah. That shit sucked.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。是哦。那破事烂透了。

lines.en: : Yumi, would you mind letting the two of us-
lines.zh: : Yumi，你能不能让我们两个——

lines.en: scene ioyuminight14
: Actually! Uh...I should probably go eat something.
lines.zh: : 其实！呃……我大概该去吃点东西了。

lines.en: : I took some anxiety meds before I came here and I’m not really supposed to be doing that on an empty stomach.
lines.zh: : 我来之前吃了点抗焦虑的药，空腹吃这个本来就不太合适。

lines.en: : Anyway, sorry for being really confusing and probably making you like me less. Please forget anything I said that may have pushed you in that direction and...remember that I...
lines.zh: : 总之，抱歉我说话很绕，大概还让你更不喜欢我了。请忘掉我说的任何可能把你往那个方向推的话，然后……记住我……

lines.en: : Nevermind.
lines.zh: : 算了。

lines.en: : See you.
lines.zh: : 回头见。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight15
: The fuck?
lines.zh: : 什么鬼？

lines.en: scene ioyuminight16
: How the hell’d you manage to scare away a girl that’s not me? Thought that shit just...never even happened to you.
lines.zh: : 你他妈是怎么把一个不是我的女生给吓跑的？我还以为这种事……从来不会发生在你身上呢。

lines.en: : I think you’re the one who scared her away. Everything was fine until you showed up.
lines.zh: : 我觉得是你把她吓跑的。你出现之前一切都还好。

lines.en: : Well, maybe “fine” is the wrong word. But it was certainly better than it is with her just...not being here, I guess?
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许「还好」这个词不太对。但总比现在这样——她就……不在这儿了——要好，大概吧？

lines.en: scene ioyuminight17
: Well, gee. Sorry for {i}showing up{/i} and preventing you from adding one more notch in your fuckin’ belt.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。抱歉我{i}出现{/i}得太及时，害你没能在你的他妈的腰带上再多刻一道。

lines.en: : Shit’s gonna get so heavy soon enough that you’ll need a second belt to even hold that one up.
lines.zh: : 再过不久，那玩意儿会重到你得再系一条腰带才撑得住。

lines.en: : That aside, Chika was looking for you earlier. She said you wouldn’t text her back or something.
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，Chika 之前在找你。她说你不回她短信之类的。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight18
: Yeah. About that.
lines.zh: : 嗯。是这么回事。

lines.en: : Chinami wanted to fill up the pool again and the fuckin’ twerp dropped my phone into the water.
lines.zh: : Chinami 想把泳池重新蓄满水，然后那个小矮子把我的手机掉水里了。

lines.en: : I knew that girl was secretly evil.
lines.zh: : 我就知道那丫头骨子里是坏的。

lines.en: : It wasn’t a big deal or whatever since I’ve heard that you can just put it in rice to fix it as long as you do it quick, but then I had to wait for the rice to cook and it was a whole fuckin’ thing.
lines.zh: : 本来也不算什么大事，我听说只要动作快，把手机埋进米里就能修好，结果我还得等米煮好，然后就是一整套的破事。

lines.en: : You-
: You’re not...supposed to {i}cook{/i} the rice, Yumi...
lines.zh: : 米……不是应该{i}煮{/i}的啊，Yumi……

lines.en: scene ioyuminight19
: What? You bein’ serious right now?
lines.zh: : 什么？你认真的？

lines.en: : You’re supposed to use uncooked rice so it can absorb the water...
lines.zh: : 应该用生米，这样它才能把水吸走……

lines.en: : You really didn’t know that?
lines.zh: : 你真的不知道这个？

lines.en: scene ioyuminight20
: Wha...How the fuck was I supposed to know that when I didn’t have a phone to look it up?!
lines.zh: : 什……我手机都坏了，你让我上哪儿去查这个啊？！

lines.en: : Oh my god...
lines.zh: : 哦我的天哪……

lines.en: : What?! I can’t be the first person to make that mistake!
lines.zh: : 什么？！我不可能是第一个犯这种错的人吧！

lines.en: : I’m going to have to buy you a new phone now, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 看来我得给你买个新手机了，是吧？

lines.en: scene ioyuminight21
: You don’t have to do shit. I’m not your fucking...girlfriend that you need to buy presents for or whatever. I’m my own person and I’ll figure it out.
lines.zh: : 你他妈什么都不用做。我又不是你的……女朋友，用不着你买礼物什么的。我是我自己的，我自己会想办法。

lines.en: : Oh, right. That reminds me.
lines.zh: : 哦，对了。这倒提醒我了。

lines.en: : I have something for you.
lines.zh: : 我有东西给你。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight22
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : You...do?
: Yeah. Hold on.
lines.zh: : 嗯。等一下。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight23
I reach into my blazer and pull out the package that Yuki handed me earlier.
lines.zh: 我把手伸进外套，掏出 Yuki 之前交给我的那个包裹。

lines.en: I still have no idea what’s inside of it, but it was light enough for me to forget about it until being reminded, so it’s probably just a shirt or scarf or something like that.
lines.zh: 我还是不知道里面是什么，但它轻得让我直到被提醒才想起来，所以大概只是件衬衫或者围巾之类的。

lines.en: : What the?...
lines.zh: : 什么鬼？……
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : Hm? It’s your birthday, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嗯？今天是你生日吧？

lines.en: : There aren’t many days of the year that it’s normal to get presents, but I’d imagine that today is one of them where you should make an exception.
lines.zh: : 一年里没几天收礼物是正常的事，但我想今天大概属于应该破例的其中一天。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 但是……

lines.en: : You and me...we’re...
lines.zh: : 你和我……我们……

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. This isn’t from me. I didn’t get you anything.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。这不是我送的。我没给你准备东西。

lines.en: scene ioyuminight24
: Huh?
Yumi snatches the present from me as I take a step back to give her room to open it.
lines.zh: 我后退一步给她腾出拆礼物的空间，Yumi 一把把礼物从我手里抢了过去。

lines.en: I probably should have prefaced this exchange by saying from the start that the gift was from her mother, but it’s out of my hands now.
lines.zh: 我大概从一开始就该先说明这礼物是她妈妈给的，但现在也已经由不得我了。

lines.en: Like, literally. I am no longer holding onto the present.
lines.zh: 字面意义上的不由我——礼物已经不在我手上了。

lines.en: : Remember how I told you your mom was working at a bar now?
lines.zh: : 还记得我跟你说过你妈妈现在在酒吧工作吗？

lines.en: : Well, she managed to scrounge up enough to get you this, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她大概好不容易才凑够钱给你买了这个。

lines.en: : I saw her earlier when I went to pick up decorations with Sana and she asked me to give it to you.
lines.zh: : 我之前和 Sana 去拿装饰品的时候见过她，她让我把这个交给你。

lines.en: : I have no idea what’s inside, but-
lines.zh: : 我不知道里面是什么，不过——

lines.en: scene ioyuminight25
: Just go.
lines.zh: : 你走。

lines.en: : Yumi, if you want me to get you something-
lines.zh: : Yumi，如果你想让我给你买点什么——

lines.en: scene ioyuminight26
: I don’t! Now get the fuck away from me!
lines.zh: : 我不想！现在给我他妈滚远点！

lines.en: : Now!
lines.zh: : 现在！

lines.en: scene black
: Okay.
I turn around to head back to the party, leaving Yumi on her own.
lines.zh: 我转身准备回派对，把 Yumi 一个人留在原地。

lines.en: The same way she always is.
lines.zh: 就像她一直是那样。
